<script type="text/javascript">

var Feedback21_rfvEmail = document.all ? document.all["Feedback21_rfvEmail"] : document.getElementById("Feedback21_rfvEmail");

Feedback21_revEmail.evaluationfunction = "RegularExpressionValidatorEvaluateIsValid";
Feedback21_revEmail.validationexpression = "\\w+([-+.\']\\w+)*@\\w+([-.]\\w+)*\\.\\w+([-.]\\w+)*";
var Feedback21_revPhone1 = document.all ? document.all["Feedback21_revPhone1"] : document.getElementById("Feedback21_revPhone1");

var Feedback21_rfvRate = document.all ? document.all["Feedback21_rfvRate"] : document.getElementById("Feedback21_rfvRate");
Feedback21_rfvRate.controltovalidate = "rblRate";

var Feedback21_rfvDescription = document.all ? document.all["Feedback21_rfvDescription"] : document.getElementById("Feedback21_rfvDescription");
